PEP: 9999
Title: A Test Proposal for ``frobnicate``
Author: Test Author <test@example.org>,
        Second Author <second@example.org>
Status: Final
Type: Standards Track
Created: 01-Jan-2024
Python-Version: 3.99


Abstract
========

This PEP proposes a :func:`frobnicate` builtin, building on :pep:`572`
and the `docs <https://example.org>`__. See also ``frob()``.


Rationale
=========

Frobnication is common. Users write helper functions for it again and again.

A second paragraph explains why the builtin form is better than a library.

.. code-block:: python

    frobnicate(x)


Rejected Ideas
--------------

A keyword was considered and rejected because it would break existing code.
